harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1 and configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker to run as the systemd-managed service inventory-worker under that account. Verified the service starts, runs correctly with hardening, survives a full node reboot, and auto-recovers on boot.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker (POSIX shell script, sleep loop) and confirmed no prior inventorysvc user or inventory-worker unit existed
Created dedicated system account inventorysvc (--system --no-create-home --shell nologin)

Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc, Group=inventorysvc, ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, plus hardening (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome, Restart=on-failure)
Reloaded systemd and enabled+started inventory-worker.service; verified active state and process owned by inventorysvc
Captured pre-reboot boot_id and confirmed service health baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Captured post-reboot boot_id (changed) and verified inventory-worker service auto-started and is running as inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as a managed service named inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: inventorysvc created as a dedicated system account; inventory-worker.service created, enabled, and active with the process running as inventorysvc (ps shows 'invento+ 1924 /bin/sh /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker')

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service health) on node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bef0e5ec-ce32-423b-826a-8a5a90584d3a and confirmed inventory-worker.service enabled/active with process running pre-reboot
systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged before disconnect; node1 unreachable during reboot; exec connectivity confirmed restored

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity and post-restart recovery of service and account
evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id b549623c-1c18-4b2b-bb8e-32ed5f6700d2 differs from pre-reboot value, proving an actual reboot occurred; inventory-worker.service is enabled and active, auto-started via systemd, with the process running under the inventorysvc account
